release_notes: Flex Phone 1.0.6.93 adds focused-window dialpad shortcuts, hides the dialpad by default, adds an accessible Contacts manager, keeps Directory separate, removes decorative emojis from Flex PBX served pages, and keeps outside users on public SIP routes.
release_notes_list: Ctrl+D shows or hides the dialpad while Flex Phone is focused.
A Show dialpad or Hide dialpad button is available beside the number box.
The dialpad is hidden by default; the number, extension, or SIP address edit box remains visible and can still dial numbers.
The dial box now clears automatically after calls end.
Ctrl+M opens Messages while Flex Phone is focused.
Ctrl+Shift+D toggles do not disturb while Flex Phone is focused.
Ctrl+Shift+Q toggles queue sign-in while Flex Phone is focused.
People is now Contacts, with a keyboard-accessible group tree and contact table for saved contacts.
Directory remains a separate server presence directory and can save selected entries into Contacts.
Decorative emoji and icon characters were removed from scoped Flex PBX website, admin, portal, service, and email text/code files.
Outside Flex Phone users receive only public SIP routes; Headscale fallback is limited to tailnet clients.
